The nightly job now counts a bank-retried payment once. The fix is committed as `6d84ef2` on `main`.

**The bug:** `run_nightly_job` in `src/orders-service-v1/nightly_job.py` counted every payment row whose `order_id` matched no order. A retry arrives as a second row with the same payment id, so it was counted twice.

**The fix:** The job now builds a dict keyed by payment id before counting, so each id is counted once. I also added `test_bank_retry_with_same_payment_id_is_counted_once` to `tests/test_orders_service_v1.py`, which fails on the old code. The full suite passes: 9 of 9 tests.

**Not committed:** Your uncommitted README note and the untracked `notes/` folder are still in the working tree, untouched.

I only checked the fix against the job's own test store. I did not look at how payments are written to the store, so if the same payment id can legitimately appear for two different payments, the dedupe would hide one of them.
